title: Buzzy Bee Drones
description: Updated Fabric Port of Buzzy Drones by HexagonNico/TeamCitrusMods.
body:
# Buzzy Bee Drones
#### Minecraft 1.20.1 Fabric Port
![Bee GIF](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ce7935d583a5054b3fc4330caa2d25a4a63c4c6.gif)

This is an unofficial port of Buzzy Drones to **Minecraft 1.20.1 (Fabric)**.

The original mod adds bee-like drones that move items between stations automatically — no configuration needed.
Drones figure out what to do on their own, making them a fun alternative to conveyor belts or item pipes.

---

## Changes in this port

- Ported from 1.19.2 multiloader to **1.20.1 Fabric** using Architectury
- Migrated removed APIs: `Material`, `Vector3f` (JOML), `Entity.level` field, `ItemStack.sameItem`, `passEvents`, `MenuType` constructor

---
